ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Status__c, "Completed"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Payment_Method__c, "UPI"), ISPICKVAL(Payment_Method__c, "Credit Card"), ISPICKVAL(Payment_Method__c, "Debit Card"), ISPICKVAL(Payment_Method__c, "Bank Transfer") ), ISBLANK(Transaction_Reference__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Transaction Reference is required for completed digital payments (UPI, Credit Card, Debit Card, Bank Transfer)
